pattern: audit-convergence on a long-tail heuristic (cycle-count escalation, signature 31501b86b1c1c0a3)
proposal_text: Phase 15 VETOs #80-#82 each found a different common resume phrasing that the negation rules mishandle (comma lists; STAR result phrases after a comma; idioms; 'not yet'; result clauses joined by 'and'). The findings are distinct and successively narrower; the shared root cause is that the plan enumerated cases instead of defining acceptance against a phrasing corpus. Process change: plans for heuristic text rules must include a versioned phrasing corpus with (1) common affirmative evidence phrasings that must keep their pre-change classification (no false downgrade) and (2) negated phrasings that must lose support. Acceptance is defined against the corpus plus documented limitations. Iteration 4 adds that corpus.
